card.name: Inside capitalized names and acronyms
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through an unusual capitalized name or acronym, such as a brand name (OTARMEN-I, Lidoderm), an institute abbreviation (IRBMED, FRF) or a place name (Cockermouth). It fires on a middle or final piece, before the name is complete.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of a split product name such as OTARMENI or Lidoderm.

modes.label: Acronyms
modes.description: A letter inside an all-caps abbreviation for an organization, facility or drug class.
modes.example: A reduction in glucose tolerance has been observed in males receiving LHR<<H>> agonists.

modes.label: Place or term fragments
modes.description: A piece like erm inside a longer name or medical word.
